Let
\[
q(y)=g(y).
\]
First compute the Fourier transform:
\[
(\mathcal F f_{M,g})(u,v)
=2^{-8}\sum_{x,y}(-1)^{x\cdot My+g(y)+x\cdot v+y\cdot u}.
\]
The inner sum over \(x\) is nonzero exactly when \(My=v\), so
\[
(\mathcal F f_{M,g})(u,v)=(-1)^{g(M^{-1}v)+u\cdot M^{-1}v}.
\]
Thus \(\mathcal F f_{M,g}=f_{M,g}\) iff
\[
M^{-1}=M,\qquad g(Mv)=g(v).
\]
So \(M\) is an involution preserving the positive-Arf quadratic form \(g\).

Also
\[
\mathcal A_f(b,\xi)
=2^{-8}\sum_x (-1)^{x\cdot Mb+g(b)+\xi\cdot x}
=
\begin{cases}
(-1)^{g(b)},&\xi=Mb,\\
0,&\xi\ne Mb.
\end{cases}
\]
Hence
\[
\mathscr T(f)=\sum_{\substack{0\ne b\in E\\Mb=b}}(-1)^{g(b)}.
\]

Fix one positive quadratic form \(q\) on \(E\). It has
\[
135
\]
nonzero singular vectors \(q(b)=0\), and
\[
120
\]
nonsingular vectors \(q(b)=1\).

For a fixed singular nonzero \(b\), the number of involutions in \(O^+(8,2)\) fixing \(b\) is
\[
9360.
\]
For a fixed nonsingular \(b\), the number is
\[
10208.
\]
These come from writing an involution as \(I+N\), \(N^2=0\), with image \(W=\operatorname{im}N\subset b^\perp\), then counting totally \(B\)-isotropic subspaces \(W\) and the compatible nondegenerate symmetric forms on \(W\). The resulting signed total for one fixed \(q\) is therefore
\[
135\cdot 9360-120\cdot 10208=38640.
\]

The number of positive quadratic forms on \(\mathbb F_2^8\) is
\[
\frac{|\operatorname{GL}(8,2)|}{|O^+(8,2)|}
=15351906304
=2^{15}\cdot 7\cdot 17\cdot 31\cdot 127.
\]
Thus the requested total is
\[
15351906304\cdot 38640.
\]
Since
\[
38640=2^4\cdot 3\cdot 5\cdot 7\cdot 23,
\]
the prime factorization is
\[
\boxed{2^{19}\cdot 3\cdot 5\cdot 7^2\cdot 17\cdot 23\cdot 31\cdot 127}.
\]
